person_note: The Goodreads quotations repeatedly expose Pearl’s participating “I” and “we” narration across family memories, migration, marriage, motherhood, and later-life reflection. The authorized opening independently establishes Pearl’s first-person voice, while the publisher’s whole-book guide and an explicit contemporary review identify Pearl as the continuing narrator. Dialogue, proverbs, universal “you,” and the embedded cicada fable were not promoted to separate narrative persons. No sustained second- or third-person section or alternate base narrator was found; the principal limitation is that the authorized prose excerpt covers only the opening, but the whole-book structural evidence and widely distributed quote evidence remove material uncertainty.
